description: The file defines the vCal class which extends SugarBean and provides methods for managing calendar vCal data, generating iCal strings, handling freebusy information, and integrating with SugarCRM activities.

classes.name: vCal
classes.description: Represents a calendar vCal in SugarCRM, providing methods for calendar data handling, iCal string generation, freebusy info, and cache management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new vCal object, disables row-level security.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for summary text.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Placeholder method to fill additional list fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Placeholder method to fill additional detail fields.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Placeholder method for list view data.

methods.name: get_freebusy_lines_cache
methods.description: Retrieves and merges freebusy lines from all vCal entries of a user.

methods.name: create_sugar_freebusy
methods.description: Creates freebusy data for SugarCRM meetings and calls within a specified time range.

methods.name: get_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Generates a vCal string with freebusy info, optionally using cached data.

methods.name: cache_sugar_vcal
methods.description: Static method to cache vCal for a user.

methods.name: cache_sugar_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Static method to cache freebusy vCal data for a user.

methods.name: fold_ical_lines
methods.description: Folds long iCal lines to comply with RFC 5545 line length limits.

methods.name: create_ical_array_from_string
methods.description: Converts an iCal string into an array of key-value pairs following RFC rules.

methods.name: create_ical_string_from_array
methods.description: Converts an array of iCal key-value pairs into a string, optionally folding lines.

methods.name: escape_ical_chars
methods.description: Escapes special characters in iCal content per RFC 5545.

methods.name: get_ical_event
methods.description: Generates an iCal VEVENT string for a given SugarBean event, for email invitations.
